concepts.gloss_en: the blemish/flaw of the altar (a defective state of the mizbe'ach)
to complete/rectify the blemish of the altar (the act of repair, achieved via converts) — not the blemish itself

members.note: action about the blemish; per rule 4, tikkun of X is not X

notes: Same Torah (lm1:17) and same construct head, but one form names the state (פגם המזבח) and the other the act of repairing it (להשלים...). Kept separate per rule 4 (action/state about X ≠ X).
